row.name: mathd_algebra_478
row.informal_prefix: /-- The volume of a cone is given by the formula $V = \frac{1}{3}Bh$, where $B$ is the area of the base and $h$ is the height. The area of the base of a cone is 30 square units, and its height is 6.5 units. What is the number of cubic units in its volume? Show that it is 65.-/
row.formal_statement:
theorem mathd_algebra_478 (b h v : ℝ) (h₀ : 0 < b ∧ 0 < h ∧ 0 < v) (h₁ : v = 1 / 3 * (b * h))
    (h₂ : b = 30) (h₃ : h = 13 / 2) : v = 65 := by
